basic_info.description: Charming Remodeled Home Nestled on a peaceful street in Bayview Heights, this beautifully remodeled home is truly move-in ready.  Virtual tour link: https://www.virtualtourcafe.com/mls/10001653  Upstairs offers two generously sized bedrooms, a full bathroom, a thoughtfully updated kitchen with a dining area, and a welcoming living room complete with a cozy fireplace.  Downstairs features a spacious two-car garage with ample storage. Step outside to a large backyardperfectly primed for your dream garden or outdoor entertaining space.  With approximately 937 sq ft of living space on a 2,495 sq ft lot, this home is a perfect blend of comfort, function, and potential.  One block to Third Street where you can find Muni.  Also, 101 free access is near by.
